question:
(i) Show that the energy density in the electric field between the plates of a parallel plate capacitor is $\frac{1}{2}\varepsilon_0E^2$.
(ii) A parallel plate capacitor in air has electric field $3 \times 10^4\text{ N C}^{-1}$ between its plates. Calculate the energy density of the electric field. Take $\varepsilon_0 = 8.85 \times 10^{-12}\text{ C}^2\text{ N}^{-1}\text{ m}^{-2}$.
